description:
A lightweight desktop AI client and screen-level agent: chat, tools, translation, OCR, and visual Q&A in one small app.

Kivio is a compact desktop AI client with a built-in agent runtime. It stays in the tray or menu bar, opens when you need it, and keeps a much smaller footprint than a browser-based AI workspace.
- Kivio Agent — chat, projects, assistants, memory, file/image attachments, MCP, Skills, and native tools (file ops, shell, web fetch/search, Pyodide run_python).
- Lens — screenshot-based visual Q&A, OCR, formula extraction, text polishing, and optional web-aware answers.
- Fast translation — typed text, selected text, windows, and arbitrary screen regions.
- Bring your own models — OpenAI-compatible providers and Anthropic Messages, with per-feature model routing and multi-key failover.
- Document-ready — PDF / Word / Excel workflows run on a bundled offline Pyodide sandbox, no first-run CDN download required.
- Private by default — no telemetry; API keys and conversation data stay on your machine.
Kivio Desktop v3.1.1
桌面 AI 助手 · macOS (Apple Silicon) + Windows。Desktop AI assistant for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows.
下载 / Downloads
- Windows 安装包 / Installer — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.1_x64-setup.exe（NSIS）
- Windows 便携版 / Portable — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.1_x64-portable.zip，解压后运行 Kivio Desktop.exe / unzip and run.
  - 需要 Edge WebView2，设置和对话与安装版共用。Requires Edge WebView2; settings and conversations are shared with the installed app.
  - 应用内更新仍下载安装包；继续使用便携版请手动下载新 ZIP。In-app updates download the NSIS installer; download the new ZIP manually to remain portable.
- macOS — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.1_aarch64.dmg（Apple Silicon，未签名 / unsigned）
  - 首次启动：右键 → 打开，或运行 xattr -cr "/Applications/Kivio Desktop.app"。
  - First launch: right-click → Open, or run the command above.
新版本亮点 / What's New
以下是 v3.1.0 → v3.1.1 的变更。These changes cover v3.1.0 → v3.1.1.
聊天与侧栏 / Chat and sidebar
- 平铺对话列表 / Flat conversation list — 侧栏可切换经典与平铺视图，按集、项目或未分组筛选；支持在当前范围新建对话，并显示项目图标。Switch between classic and flat sidebar views, filter by set, project, or ungrouped chats, and create conversations in the selected scope with project icons.
- 历史与草稿 / History and drafts — 向上滚动自动加载更早消息，保留阅读锚点、请求去重和失败重试；完善历史输入与目标模式草稿，插入引用即时同步到输入框。Load earlier messages while scrolling upward, preserving reading anchors, request deduplication, and retries; improve input history, goal drafts, and immediate inserted-text updates.
- 多模型回答 / Multi-model answers — 可删除单个模型回答而保留提问及其它回答；恢复选中文字的「添加到聊天」入口，修复正式构建的大纲标记。Delete an individual model answer while keeping its question and siblings; restore selected-text quoting and production outline markers.
- 正文显示 / Message rendering — 保留普通下划线、文件名和标识符，改进分栏与侧栏标签布局。Preserve literal underscores, filenames, and identifiers, and improve split-pane and sidebar-tab layouts.
集备份 / Set backups
- 导出与恢复 / Export and restore — 集可连同提示词、助手、对话、附件和钉住位置导出、导入；设置备份也包含集及默认助手。Export and restore sets with prompts, assistants, conversations, attachments, and pinned positions; settings backups also include sets and default assistants.
- 恢复保护 / Restore safeguards — 保留外部 CLI 的原生会话绑定及原工作目录约束，拒绝重复绑定，写入时同步对话标识；导入失败会清理本次新增文件。Preserve native CLI bindings and original-directory constraints, reject duplicate bindings, align conversation identifiers when writing, and clean up newly created files on import failure.
模型、插件与用量 / Models, plugins, and usage
- 无 Key 端点 / Keyless endpoints — 聊天、模型发现和连接测试支持不填 API Key；空 Key 不发送鉴权头，服务端鉴权错误仍正常反馈，OAuth 仍需登录。Chat, model discovery, and connection tests support endpoints without API keys; empty keys omit authentication headers, server authentication errors remain visible, and OAuth still requires login.
- 混音器角色 / Mixer roles — 为 TASK、SMOL、SLOW 分别配置模型与推理强度；未配置角色跟随 TASK，再回落到主对话。Configure models and reasoning effort for TASK, SMOL, and SLOW; unconfigured roles inherit TASK, then the parent conversation.
- 原生插件包 / Native plugin packages — 市场新增随应用提供的云服务、开发工具、文档和媒体能力包，统一组件安装、启停及详情展示。Expand the marketplace with bundled cloud, development, document, and media capability packages, with unified component installation, enablement, and details.
- 上下文与费用 / Context and costs — 上下文表盘使用供应商上报值，避免旧快照覆盖新测量；对话费用累计主对话与子代理的已记录请求，并改进 Token 趋势图。Use provider-reported context measurements and reject stale snapshots; conversation costs include recorded parent and sub-agent requests, with clearer token trend charts.
桌面与兼容性 / Desktop and compatibility
- macOS 交通灯 / macOS window controls — 改进窗口布局、缩放和复用时的交通灯位置恢复。Improve traffic-light positioning across window layout, resizing, and reuse.
- 墨墨桌宠 / Momo desktop pet — 更新姿态、表情和状态动作，调整短句气泡及明暗主题显示。Refresh poses, expressions, and activity animations, and refine speech cards for light and dark themes.
- Node 20 测试 / Node 20 tests — 修复延迟 Promise 测试的兼容问题，保留异步结果先后顺序的回归断言。Fix deferred-promise test compatibility while preserving assertions for asynchronous result ordering.
完整变更 / Full changelog: https://github.com/ZMGID/kivio/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1
